CATHAY
HOTEL
CABLE ADDRESS
CATHOTEL"
SHANGHAI. CHINA.
Sunday April 23'33
Dearest Debs
Groeger, the lucky dog, has finished his part
of our job in China and is leaving tonight for home.
I am asking him to take this letter to you and to get
in touch with you in person as soon as possible to
tell you ab out our trip and the present status of
negotiations. The cable ordering Groeger home came this
morning and you never saw a happier man in your life
than that Dutchman. Of course it has been a sad day for
me not that I will mind missing G but the thought of
him and his luck has made me plenty jealous and terr-
ibly homesick. I am sending some night gowns by G
which cost about $ 3.00 each. If they are any good
you can write me and
I will get some more - better ones
if you like which cost about twice as much but are very
elab orate. It was for that reason that I bought these.
Maybe you can give them away if they are no good. I am
also sending with the nighties some cock tail sets. I
am terribly sorry but I can not remember whether I sent
the blue ones to Ruth or to 4904. Please send them all
out to Ma and ask her to get together with Ruth.
I have been very busy and believe have made some
real progress. You see I was really unable to do any-
thing until the deal for the acquisition of China Air
by PAA on April Ist. Now am making some real strides.
Had a grand party for the Doolittles Friday. Everyone
said it was the best party which has been given. Had
lots of people to whom I was under obligations.Dr.Fearn
the Hutchins, Howards, Jouetts, Arnolds and others. All
seemed to enjoy the dinner and
dancing •
Groeger and I
are now going over reports and later I will go out to
the boat with him to say
"good bye"
Lots and lots of love
and
the kids -
Had
P. S.
Also raelor hirt wek laat of 12 dole
and
the
latter
a cay handka cod on or had dec
good luck!
properties.sfomuseum:description: Typewritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated Sunday, April 23, 1933, on stationery from Cathay Hotel in Shanghai, with handwritten note at end; includes description of [Paul] Groeger leaving China and brief update on his work with CNAC, party for [James “Jimmy” and Josephine] Doolittle.
